$comment: Kit performance budgets. Measured baseline 2026-10-12 (raw/gzip bytes): worker entry 2551/1219; server JS total (22 files, no sourcemaps) 962157/258300 — dominated by the Hono catch-all bundle (chunks/hono.js 433009); client JS total (11 files) 100252/39302; client CSS total (1 file) 2402/763. Ceilings are measured size x1.25 rounded up (raw to 512B, gzip to 256B), the repository x1.25 rule from ci/bundle-budget.json. Client/server hashed-asset groups are budgeted as totals plus a file-count cap, so a new chunk fails closed instead of escaping enforcement. Startup.maxMs (60s, the same cold-start bound as ci/kit-worker-e2e.mjs's listen) is enforced as the Kit webServer readiness timeout in playwright.kit-parity.config.ts; the parity spec additionally records warm first-200 latency as a report annotation under a 10s liveness bound. Raising a ceiling needs an explicit decision explaining the growth; never relax a budget to make CI green. 2026-10-13 decision (join landing): main measures 31 server files and the /join route adds 5 (2 page entries + 1 SvelteKit node + Vite re-partitioning the shared 437k Hono catch-all into chunks/src.js and splitting chunks/kit-session.js for the flash/widget load) for 36 total; byte totals still fit with ~15% margin (raw 1014543, gzip 275405, branch raw below main's 1025212), so only the file-count cap moves, 32 to 45 (36 x1.25, the repository rule), preserving fail-closed for unexpected chunks. 2026-10-13 decision (homepage): the home route adds 6 server files (route entries, one route node, and the home-copy/featured/seo-json-ld shared chunks) for 37 total alone with byte totals 1022328/278333 raw/gzip inside the unchanged byte ceilings; the 45 cap stands for both routes combined. Fresh combined rebuild 2026-10-13 measures 42 server files (raw/gzip 1030288/281614), correcting the earlier stale-output count of 37. Homepage copy now travels through the SSR-only server load, eliminating an unused shared client chunk; the combined client fits its unchanged 16-file and byte ceilings. Further growth still fails closed for review. 2026-10-13 decision (merge main #828/#829): the combined build measures 47 server files and 17 client files (client raw 124734/gzip 50102, over the old 16-file and 49152B gzip caps); the rules route and past-events rework contribute entries and chunk repartitioning, but the home route is the cause of the overrun above the pre-home caps: +7 server files and +1 client node (nodes/2 11.5 KB raw) for about +12.2 KB raw and +4.9 KB gzip of client JS, so this head fails the old caps (47 over 45, 17 over 16, 50102 over 49152) while main fits them. Per the repository x1.25 rule the caps move as an explicit decision, not to make CI green: server files 45 to 59 (47 x1.25), client files 16 to 22 (17 x1.25), client raw 125440 to 156160, client gzip 49152 to 62720. Byte ceilings for worker/server and the CSS group are unchanged; the disabled home route still ships one client node under csr=false, and further chunks still fail closed for review. 2026-10-13 correction (homepage review): fresh rebuild measures server 47 files (raw 1044967/gzip 288919, inside the unchanged server byte ceilings) and client 17 files (raw 124734/gzip 50102); caps above stay at measured x1.25 by explicit decision.
